correctness.rationale: The exact two-dimensional covariance transfer was derived from Bernoulli moments and checked by exhaustive rational-mask enumeration in 72 cases. The determinant identity, signs, root localization, no-reentry argument and strict gap are analytic; 360 parameter-side eigenvalue checks are supportive only. Universal necessity follows from positivity of covariance transfer and symmetry of coordinate basis starts, not from a finite search. The standalone verifier replays these statements.

value.rationale: Independent synchronous Bernoulli masks and equicorrelated SPD Hessians are an interpretable, natural model of parallel partial participation. This complete all-dimensional sharp stability law gives a computable safe gain and proves a robust regime in which per-step expected objective descent fails yet the algorithm converges mean square. It clarifies the cost and conservatism of ESO descent tuning, beyond a numeric instance. The theorem is limited to this symmetric family.
